240-2292-5470-8296.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability, causing you to scry 1
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

728-2700-6972.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Arcbound Shikari.
When Arcbound Shikari dies, its modular ability and persist ability trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting Arcbound Shikari's +1/+1 counters on another artifact creature.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Arcbound Shikari from your graveyard to the battlefield. It will not have a -1/-1 counter on it due to its modular ability.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Repeat.

567-4186-7743.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
567-4186-7743.description:
Gain life.
Heroic Feast triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Soul's Attendant triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

4246-5540-7512.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause an artifact, creature, or enchantment to enter the battlefield.
An opponent controls an artifact.
If you are going to have a nonartifact creature or enchantment enter the battlefield, an opponent must also control either a creature or enchantment respectively.
4246-5540-7512.description:
Cause an artifact, creature or enchantment to enter the battlefield.
Confusion in the Ranks triggers, exchanging control of the permanent that entered with an opponent for another permanent of the same type.
Zidane triggers, creating a Treasure token.
When the Treasure enters, Confusion in the Ranks triggers, exchanging control of the Treasure with an opponent for another artifact.
Repeat from step 3.
4246-5540-7512.notes: Null Rod prevents the opponents from sacrificing the Treasures for mana. Without it, your opponents can sacrifice the Treasures and stop you (eventually) from exchanging control of artifacts.

4559-4802-5256-7306.notablePrerequisites: Noncreature artifacts you control have total mana value 11 or greater.
4559-4802-5256-7306.description:
Cast Metalwork Colossus by paying {0}, which enters with at least two +1/+1 counters on it due to Master Biomancer.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Metalwork Colossus.
When Metalwork Colossus dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen token for each +1/+1 counter Metalwork Colossus had.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Activate Metalwork Colossus by sacrificing two Mutagens, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1870-4873-7280.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 20 minus 1 for each charge counter on Darksteel Reactor.
1870-4873-7280.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to put an artifact into your graveyard from the battlefield.
1870-4873-7280.description:
Cast Eternity Vessel by paying {6}. It will enter with a number of charge counters on it equal to your life total.
Cause Eternity Vessel to leave the battlefield. When it does, Donatello triggers, putting a number of charge counters on Darksteel Reactor equal to the number Eternity Vessel had on it.
Darksteel Reactor triggers, causing you to win the game.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

1477-6972-7154.description:
Activate Extruder by sacrificing Arcbound Condor.
When Arcbound Condor dies, its modular ability and persist ability trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting Arcbound Condor's +1/+1 counters on another artifact creature.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Arcbound Condor from your graveyard to the battlefield. It will not have a -1/-1 counter on it due to its modular ability.
Resolve the Extruder ability.
Repeat.

985-4549-5051-5078.description:
Activate Relic of Legends' second ability by tapping Traxos, adding {1}.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Traxos triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat.

1793-1965-5220.description:
Cast Omarthis by paying {0}.
Omarthis enters and dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness, triggering Mortuary and Harvester of Souls.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Omarthis from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Harvester of Souls trigger, causing you to draw a card, thus drawing Omarthis from your library.
Repeat.

2173-5073-5220-5931.description:
Activate Tinder Wall by sacrificing it.
When Tinder Wall dies, Mortuary and Funeral Room // Awakening Hall trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Tinder Wall from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Funeral Room // Awakening Hall trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Cast Tinder Wall from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

2173-2448-4063-5220.easyPrerequisites: It is your precombat main phase.
2173-2448-4063-5220.description:
Activate Goblin Firestarter by sacrificing it.
When Goblin Firestarter dies, Mortuary and Fleshtaker trigger.
Resolve the Fleshtaker trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and scry 1.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Goblin Firestarter from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Goblin Firestarter ability.
Cast Goblin Firestarter from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

851-934-4508-5880.description:
Activate Magmaw by paying {1} and sacrificing another nonland permanent, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Malcolm triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

5412-5478-5531-6621.easyPrerequisites: Other lands you control can tap to produce at least {4}{C}.
5412-5478-5531-6621.description:
Activate any number of other lands by tapping them, adding at least {4}{C}.
Activate Coastal Hornclaw by sacrificing a land except Mirrorpool.
Repeat step 2 until you control no lands except Mirrorpool.
Activate Mirrorpool's third ability by paying {4}{C}, tapping and sacrificing it, creating a token copy of Lumra.
Put the Lumra token into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
The Lumra token's enters-the-battlefield ability triggers, causing you to mill four cards and return all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Spelunking.
Repeat.

108-4013-6441.description:
Activate Eldrazi Displacer by paying {2}{C}, blinking Eyeless Watcher.
When Eyeless Watcher enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating four 1/1 Eldrazi Scion creature tokens.
Activate three Eldrazi Scions by sacrificing them, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.

1365-1379-4853-5686--20.easyPrerequisites:
An opponent was dealt damage this turn.
The creature with bloodthirst does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
1365-1379-4853-5686--20.description:
Activate Cauldron of Souls by tapping it, giving the creature with bloodthirst persist until end of turn.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing the creature with bloodthirst.
When the creature dies, its persist ability and Dross Scorpion trigger.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield, which enters the battlefield with at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to its bloodthirst ability.
Resolve the Dross Scorpion trigger, untapping Cauldron of Souls.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability
Repeat.

413-586-5258-5618-5687.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Skittering Precursor and Rakdos trigger.
Resolve the Skittering Precursor trigger, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
When the Eldrazi Spawn enters the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Priest of Gix from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile the top three cards of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying {3}.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Priest of Gix trigger, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Repeat.

requires.n: Legendary Creature with Flying and MV >= 4

2533-5147-5925--70.description:
During your precombat main phase, activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the legendary creature with flying.
When the creature dies, Jackdaw Savior triggers, returning Loyal Retainers from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Activate Loyal Retainers by sacrificing it, returning the legendary creature with flying from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

1947-3362-4313.manaNeeded: {3}{B}{B}{R}{R} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
1947-3362-4313.description:
Cast Bladewing the Risen by paying {3}{B}{B}{R}{R} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Bladewing the Risen enters the battlefield, it and Flameshadow Conjuring trigger.
Resolve the Bladewing the Risen trigger, returning Reckless Barbarian from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Reckless Barbarian enters the battlefield, Flameshadow Conjuring triggers.
Holding priority, activate Reckless Barbarian by sacrificing it, adding {R}{R}.
Resolve the Flameshadow Conjuring trigger from step 4, causing you to pay {R} to create a token copy of Reckless Barbarian with haste.
Resolve the Flameshadow Conjuring trigger from step 2, causing you to pay {R} to create a token copy of Bladewing the Risen with haste.
Put all but the Bladewing the Risen token into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the token Bladewing the Risen enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning the nontoken Bladewing the Risen from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Put the nontoken Bladewing the Risen into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Repeat from step 2.

152-1434-4155.description:
Activate Cogwork Assembler by paying {7}, creating a token copy of The Stasis Coffin.
Activate the Stasis Coffin token by paying {2}, tapping and exiling it, giving you protection from everything until your next turn.
Repeat each turn.

2393-2577-4871-5009.description:
Activate Ruthless Knave's first ability by paying {2}{B} and sacrificing Gravecrawler.
Gravecrawler dies, triggering Pitiless Plunderer and Sifter of Skulls.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Sifter of Skulls trigger, creating a 1/1 Eldrazi Scion creature token.
Resolve the Ruthless Knave ability from step 1, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate the Eldrazi Scion by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
The Eldrazi Scion dies, triggering Pitiless Plunderer, creating a Treasure token.
Activate three Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}{B}.
Cast Gravecrawler from your graveyard by paying {B}.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite Treasure tokens, you may activate Ruthless Knave's last ability any number of times.

372-1409.notablePrerequisites:
Nonland permanent card(s) you own that can produce at least {2}{U} exiled by Abdel Adrian.
Deadeye Navigator is paired with Abdel Adrian.
372-1409.description:
Activate Abdel Adrian by paying {1}{U}, blinkng itself.
Abdel Adrian leaves and enters the battlefield, causing all cards exiled with it to return to the battlefield from exile, and triggering Abdel Adrian's enters-the-battlefield ability and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability.
Holding priority, activate the nonland mana-producing permanent(s) by tapping them, adding at least {2}{U}.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Abdel Adrian.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling the nonland mana-producing permanent(s) and creating that many 1/1 Soldier creature tokens.
Each Soldier enters the battlefield, triggering Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability that many times.
Resolve all Deadeye Navigator triggers, choosing not to pair it and a Soldier token.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may use Deadeye Navigator's abilities to blink any number of creatures you control any number of times.

176-2837-5231.description:
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing any other non-Spirit you control, adding {R}.
The creature dies, triggering Requiem Angel, creating either a 2/2 Cat or a 3/1 Dog creature token.
Repeat.

15-413-643-1339.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
15-413-643-1339.description:
Draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token.
The Insect enters the battlefield, triggering Blasting Station, untapping Blasting Station.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing the Insect.
Laid to Rest triggers, causing you to draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token.
The Insect enters the battlefield, triggering Blasting Station, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 4, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat from step 4.

3995-4474-4684.notablePrerequisites:
Horseshoe Crab does not have summoning sickness.
Paradise Mantle attached to Horseshoe Crab.
3995-4474-4684.description:
Activate Horseshoe Crab by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Horseshoe Crab by paying {U}, untapping Horseshoe Crab.
Mesmeric Orb triggers, causing you to mill a card.
Repeat.
